page.overview:
Who is Glove?

Commander Glove is a Marine commander that participated in the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

Glove is a thin man dressed in a standard Marine soldier outfit with an overcoat. He also wears a Marine cap, and blue boxing gloves.

In the anime, he has a metal brace around his face, puffy hair, and a slight beard.

Glove is a confident man as he believes in his abilities, rather than relying on using a gun or sword as most Marines do.
